input_fields.name: failed_precondition
input_fields.description: One failed persistence/export precondition, exact error, and affected artifact.

input_fields.name: target_artifact_identity
input_fields.description: Expected path, format, role, and run ownership.

input_fields.name: repair_strategy
input_fields.description: One selected strategy such as new writable path or supported format.

result_fields.name: repaired_condition
result_fields.description: One corrected path/format/permission precondition and scope.

result_fields.name: repair_action
result_fields.description: One preparation action or needs_manual_review; no persistence command.

result_fields.name: needs_manual_review
result_fields.description: True when cause or strategy is not specific enough.

procedure: Classify the single failure as path/ownership, format, or permission; reject mixed causes.
Apply one strategy: choose run-owned writable path, supported format, or user-writable directory without changing ACLs.
Return repaired_condition and one preparation action; leave persistence operation to its own atom.
If cause/identity is unclear, return needs_manual_review with no guessed path/format.
rejection_rules: Reject deletion/overwrite of baseline/evidence or changing multiple preconditions.
Reject generic retry without changing the located condition.
